name: How does personal use affect a vacation rental's eligibility for a 1031 exchange?

mainEntity.name: How does personal use affect a vacation rental's eligibility for a 1031 exchange?

acceptedAnswer.text: Personal use is a critical factor for 1031 exchange eligibility. The IRS considers a vacation home an investment property if it is rented for 14 days or more per year and your personal use does not exceed the greater of 14 days or 10% of the total days it is rented. Exceeding these personal use limits can jeopardize the property's qualification as being 'held for productive use in a trade or business or for investment,' potentially disqualifying it from the exchange. Reviewing your usage history is a key preparation step.
acceptedAnswer.description: Excessive personal use (more than 14 days or 10% of rental days) can disqualify a vacation rental from a 1031 exchange.
